mara.design: A 19-year-old young woman with a low, dry, slightly husky voice. Tired and protective older sister; speaks quietly and tensely, sharp when she gives orders. Natural cinematic acting, not theatrical.
mara.ref: Stay behind me and keep quiet. I don't know what that is, but we are not opening that door tonight.

mom.design: A 45-year-old mother with a warm, tired, slightly worried voice, just woken up in the middle of the night. Natural, quiet, realistic phone conversation.
mom.ref: It's the middle of the night, sweetheart. Everyone is asleep. Tell me slowly what happened down there.

tim.design: A six-year-old little boy with a small, high, soft voice. Unnaturally calm and slow, almost flat, as if reciting; quiet and close to the listener.
tim.ref: It is very dark in here and I have been waiting for a long time. Please open the door for me.

lines: Whose is that? Nobody else is down here.
Not ours. Just load the thing, I want to go to bed.
Leo? It's dark in here. Let me out.
In his bed. I'm looking right at him. Why?
She's lying. That isn't me up there. Open the door, Leo.
Mara, who is that? Who's talking?
